column1: Finely grate the Parmigiano Reggiano and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line 8 cups of a muffin pan with paper liners or parchment squares.
Sift the flour, salt, and baking powder into a large bowl, then mix in the sugar, the spinach, and about two-thirds of the cheese.
In a jug, beat the egg, milk, and oil together.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry and stir gently just until no dry flour remains. The batter should stay lumpy.
Divide the batter among the muffin cups and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Bake 20–25 minutes until risen and golden. Serve warm.
